user.title: KinCony KC868 MQTT Controller
user.description: Configure MQTT topics. The integration will wait for the first retained STATE message and detect available I/O.

data_description.mqtt_prefix: Example: KC868_A16/ECC9FF002428. If topics are left empty, STATE and SET are appended automatically.
data_description.refresh_payload: Optional MQTT command sent after integration startup. Leave empty when retained STATE works.

mapping.title: I/O mapping
mapping.description: Detected: {inputs} inputs, {outputs} outputs, {adcs} ADC channels, {sensors} sensor blocks. Edit the JSON mapping. Set enabled=true and choose type. Inputs support binary_sensor. Outputs support switch, light, button. Cover entities are intentionally not created.

error.no_state_message: No MQTT STATE message was received. Check topic, broker and whether the retained STATE message exists.

abort.already_configured: This MQTT prefix is already configured.

init.title: Edit I/O mapping
init.description: Edit the JSON mapping. Restart/reload the integration after changing entity types.
